add: a + b + c + ... + n_term; can be list.
mul: a * b * c * ... * n_term; can be list.
sqrt: value x when multiplied to itself gives a(input), thus; x*x = a; only 1 input
arithmetic_average: average; (a+b+c+...+n_term)/(no of terms), can be list
abs: absolute, if number n is < 0; then -(n), if 0; then 0; if > 0 then n.; 1 input only
min: minimum of the given values, can be list
max: maximum of the given values, can be list
random-int: generated a random integer between given inputs. 2 inputs(min, max);
random: generated a random number using computer entropy. generates a 13-16 digit number, HIGH RESOURCE!, NO inputs
round: rounds number to given decimal places, 2 inputs(input_number, decimal_places)
clamp: makes the value stay under desired values, 3 inputs(input_value, min_value, max_value)
